_doc_notes: PARTIAL schema covering only the tables and fields the 5 calibration
examples touch. PR 10.5b expands as more examples land.
Source: NetSuite SuiteScript public docs (Records Browser).
Note: the SuiteScript Records Browser is hosted at system.netsuite.com
and requires a NetSuite account login for the latest version. Kaan
to confirm exact URLs against the most recent release notes; the
field NAMES below match SuiteScript convention (lowercase, no
separator) which has been stable across releases.
Target: Rootstock Object Reference. Rootstock is built on the
Salesforce platform; objects use the __c suffix for custom
objects and fields per Salesforce convention.
- Customer__c: Rootstock Object Reference, Customer__c entry.
Object reference is typically behind the customer center login;
Kaan to confirm exact field names from the Rootstock Object
Reference his account has access to.

fields.name: entityid
fields.description: Unique customer identifier. Often the customer code (e.g. 'CUST-12345'). NetSuite-internal canonical id is `id` (system-generated); `entityid` is the user-visible external code that customers and integrations key on. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer.entityid.

fields.name: companyname
fields.description: Company name. Required for non-individual customers. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer.companyname.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for the customer entity. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer.email.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Reference to NetSuite Currency record. Stored as the currency record's internal id; the human-readable code (USD, EUR) is on the joined Currency record. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer.currency (List/Record - Currency).

fields.name: billaddr1
fields.description: Billing address line 1. Part of the address sublist; flattened here for the calibration sample. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer addressbookList.addressbook.addressLine1.

fields.name: billcity
fields.description: Billing address city. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer addressbookList.addressbook.city.

fields.name: billstate
fields.description: Billing address state/province (2-character code in US). Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer addressbookList.addressbook.state.

fields.name: billzip
fields.description: Billing address postal code. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Customer addressbookList.addressbook.zip.

fields.name: tranid
fields.description: Sales order transaction id (e.g. 'SO-00012345'). The user-visible order number. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Transaction.tranid.

fields.name: entity
fields.description: Customer the order belongs to. Stored as the Customer record's internal id. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, SalesOrder.entity (List/Record - Customer).

fields.name: trandate
fields.description: Order transaction date. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Transaction.trandate.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Order total in the transaction's currency. Includes tax, shipping, and discounts. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Transaction.total.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Reference to Currency record for this transaction. Source: SuiteScript Records Browser, Transaction.currency.

fields.name: External_ID__c
fields.description: External system identifier for cross-system reconciliation. The canonical migration target for source-system unique customer codes. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Customer__c.External_ID__c. NOTE FROM CLAUDE: Kaan to confirm the exact field name; some Rootstock packages also expose `Account_Number__c` and `Customer_Number__c` as candidates; External_ID__c is the most widely cited.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Standard Salesforce Name field on Customer__c. For a custom object, this is auto-generated unless overridden. Used as the customer's display name in Rootstock. Source: Salesforce Object Reference standard fields + Rootstock Customer__c entry.

fields.name: Email__c
fields.description: Primary contact email. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Customer__c.Email__c. NOTE FROM CLAUDE: Kaan to confirm — Rootstock may use a Contact-related lookup pattern instead of a direct field; if so, the gold mapping target would shift to a related Contact record.

fields.name: Currency_Code__c
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'USD'). Rootstock objects under Salesforce multicurrency typically use the standard CurrencyIsoCode field, but Rootstock packages also frequently expose a Currency_Code__c custom field that mirrors the ISO code. Source: Rootstock Object Reference. NOTE FROM CLAUDE: this is one of the higher-uncertainty mappings — Kaan to confirm whether Rootstock uses CurrencyIsoCode (standard SF) or Currency_Code__c (custom).

fields.name: Billing_Address__c
fields.description: Single-field rolled-up billing address (long text). Used when Rootstock prefers a flat single-line/multi-line address rather than the structured billing_street/city/state/postal_code fields. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Customer__c. NOTE FROM CLAUDE: Rootstock may instead use Salesforce's compound BillingAddress field (BillingStreet, BillingCity, etc.) on a related Account record. If so, the address example becomes a one-to-many mapping into structured fields rather than a many-to-one concat.

fields.name: External_ID__c
fields.description: External system identifier for the order. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Sales_Order__c.External_ID__c.

fields.name: Customer__c
fields.description: Lookup to Customer__c. Salesforce master-detail or lookup field. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Sales_Order__c.Customer__c.

fields.name: Order_Date__c
fields.description: Date the order was placed. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Sales_Order__c.Order_Date__c.

fields.name: Total_Amount__c
fields.description: Order total in the transaction's currency. NUMERIC(18,2) per Salesforce currency convention. Source: Rootstock Object Reference, Sales_Order__c.Total_Amount__c.

fields.name: Currency_Code__c
fields.description: Same caveat as Customer__c.Currency_Code__c — CurrencyIsoCode (standard SF) vs Currency_Code__c (custom) is a Rootstock-package detail that Kaan should confirm.
